title: Change of variables from ℝⁿ into WithLp 2 (ℝᵐ × ℝᵏ) with normDet Jacobian (parent step 6)
statement: Notation: ℝ^d = Rn d = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d); n := m + k; P := WithLp 2 (ℝᵐ × ℝᵏ) with its volume (the Lebesgue measure of the finite-dimensional inner product space P); Lⁿ = volume; normDet = LinearMap.normDet of the underlying linear map. Statement. Let m, k ∈ ℕ, f : ℝⁿ → P, f' : ℝⁿ → (ℝⁿ →L[ℝ] P) and B ⊆ ℝⁿ Borel, such that f has derivative f'(u) within B at every u ∈ B (HasFDerivWithinAt f (f' u) B u) and f is injective on B. Then for every function g : P → [0, ∞] (no measurability assumed): ∫_{f(B)} g d(volume) = ∫_B ofReal(normDet(f'(u)))·g(f(u)) dLⁿ(u).
lean_statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (f : Rn (m + k) → WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k)) (f' : Rn (m + k) → Rn (m + k) →L[ℝ] WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k)) (B : Set (Rn (m + k))), MeasurableSet B → (∀ u ∈ B, HasFDerivWithinAt f (f' u) B u) → InjOn f B → ∀ g : WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k) → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ w in f '' B, g w = ∫⁻ u in B, ENNReal.ofReal ((f' u).toLinearMap.normDet) * g (f u)
